comparisons.peer_summary: To ensure timely repayment of commercial paper, each asset pool is associated with a minimum 100% deal-specific liquidity facility provided by JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A., which also supplies uncommitted program-wide liquidity and credit enhancement in the form of standby letters of credit approximating 10% of outstanding commercial paper.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citi and JPMorgan disclose providing program-wide credit enhancement to their multi-seller conduits in the form of letters of credit, with both companies approximating the amount at 10% of the outstanding commercial paper or conduit assets. Citi specifies its letters of credit total $2.1 billion and equal at least 8% to 10% of conduit assets, while JPMorgan notes that its program-wide credit enhancement in the form of standby letters of credit approximates 10% of the outstanding balance of commercial paper.

sentences.text: The letters of credit provided by the Company to the conduits total approximately $2.1 billion as of December 31, 2024 and $2.1 billion as of December 31, 2023.
The conduits have obtained letters of credit from the Company that equal at least 8% to 10% of the conduit's assets with a minimum of $200 million to $350 million.
The amount of program-wide credit enhancement required is based upon commercial paper issuance and approximates 10% of the outstanding balance of commercial paper.

To ensure timely repayment of the commercial paper, and to provide the conduits with funding to provide financing to customers in the event that the conduits do not obtain funding in the commercial paper market, each asset pool financed by the conduits has a minimum 100% deal-specific liquidity facility associated with it provided by JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. also provides the multi-seller conduit vehicles with uncommitted program-wide liquidity facilities and program-wide credit enhancement in the form of standby letters of credit.
